title: Morning Rule
subtitle: A simple morning prayer for daily use
intro: Stand facing east if you can, or facing your icons. Make the Sign of the Cross. Then pray each of the following in order, slowly.
source: Common Orthodox prayer book (PD English; the Jordanville, St. Tikhon's, and Hapgood Service Book traditions all carry these prayers in nearly identical form).

prayers.title: The Sign of the Cross
prayers.instruction: Bring the right hand to the forehead, then to the abdomen, then to the right shoulder, then to the left shoulder, saying:
prayers.text: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

prayers.title: Glory to Thee, our God
prayers.text: Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.

prayers.title: O Heavenly King
prayers.text: O Heavenly King, the Comforter, the Spirit of Truth, who art everywhere present and fillest all things, Treasury of good things and Giver of life: come and abide in us, cleanse us from every stain, and save our souls, O Good One.

prayers.title: The Trisagion
prayers.instruction: Three times, with a small bow at each:
prayers.text:
Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us. (3x)

Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

Most Holy Trinity, have mercy on us. Lord, cleanse us from our sins. Master, pardon our iniquities. Holy God, visit and heal our infirmities, for Thy Name's sake.

Lord, have mercy. (3x)

Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

prayers.title: The Lord's Prayer
prayers.text: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy Name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.

prayers.title: Rising from Sleep
prayers.text:
Rising from sleep, I thank Thee, O Holy Trinity, for through Thy great goodness and patience Thou wast not wroth with me, an idle and sinful one, neither hast Thou destroyed me with my iniquities, but hast shown Thy customary love for mankind, and hast raised me up as I lay in heedlessness, that I might sing my morning hymn and glorify Thy might.

Do Thou now enlighten the eyes of my mind, open my mouth to meditate on Thy words, to understand Thy commandments, to do Thy will, to sing to Thee in confession of heart, and to praise Thy most holy Name: of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

prayers.title: The Jesus Prayer
prayers.instruction: Slowly, ten times. Use your fingers or a prayer rope if you have one.
prayers.text: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner. (10x)

prayers.title: To the Theotokos
prayers.text:
Most holy Theotokos, save us.

It is truly meet to bless thee, O Theotokos, ever-blessed and most pure, and the Mother of our God. More honorable than the Cherubim, and more glorious beyond compare than the Seraphim, who without corruption gavest birth to God the Word: true Theotokos, we magnify thee.

prayers.title: Dismissal
prayers.text:
Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

Lord, have mercy. (3x) Bless.

Through the prayers of our holy fathers, Lord Jesus Christ our God, have mercy on us. Amen.
